clue.text: He works so that others may play

definitions.text: He works so that others may play

parts.words: He works so that others may play
parts.note: the person whose works are pieces of music written for performers to play

explanation.surface: A selfless worker toils so that others can enjoy their leisure.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of music produces works that musicians then play, so he works so that others may play.

clue.text: One who talks one round to composing some music

parts.note: an orator is one who talks, a public speaker
the Roman numeral for one is I
a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: A public speaker, after one round of talking, turns to writing some music.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large-scale choral work, so it is some music.

clue.text: High water mark for cargo vessels

definitions.text: High water mark for cargo vessels

parts.words: High water mark for cargo vessels
parts.note: the load line painted on a ship's hull showing how deep it may safely sit in the water

explanation.definitionFit: The load line on a merchant ship's side marks the highest level water may reach when the vessel is laden, named after Samuel Plimsoll.

clue.text: The rest of the after noon

definitions.text: The rest of the after noon

parts.words: The rest of the after noon
parts.note: read as the nap taken after midday rather than the remainder of the afternoon

explanation.definitionFit: A siesta is a midday or early-afternoon nap, a rest taken after noon.

clue.text: Travel free on top of elephant

definitions.text: Travel free on top of elephant

parts.words: Travel free on top of elephant
parts.note: a journey taken sitting on an animal's back, with a hint of a free trip

explanation.definitionFit: To ride is to travel carried by a vehicle or animal, such as sitting atop an elephant.

clue.text: This sort of order will make a man stoic

indicators.note: the letters of the words that follow are reworked to make something new

explanation.surface: Joining a religious order will turn a man into a stoic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will make' rearranges MAN STOIC; 'a' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A religious order of monks is a monastic order, so this sort of order describes the adjective.

clue.text: Mark shows unending alarm

indicators.note: without its ending, so the final letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: to alarm someone is to scare them

explanation.surface: A blemish reveals a never-ending sense of alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unending' cuts the last letter E from SCARE.
explanation.definitionFit: A scar is a mark left on the skin by a healed wound.

clue.text: Faces the wall, perhaps

parts.note: read not as turning towards a wall but as covering a wall's surface with a smooth coat

explanation.definitionFit: A plasterer plasters a wall, coating or facing its surface with plaster.

clue.text: Press one to state con elusion is intended as satire

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Press one to state con elusion is intended as satire': OCR garble; IRON + I + CAL is likely but 'con elusion' cannot be restored from the held text, and no scan or search gives the printed clue.
annotationWithheld.clue: Press one to state con elusion is intended as satire

clue.text: I ask for foreign drink

indicators.note: something foreign is strange or out of place, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks for an exotic drink abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foreign' rearranges I ASK; 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Saki is a variant spelling of sake, the Japanese rice wine, so it is a drink.

clue.text: Senior NCO on board is a weapons expert

definitions.meaning: the chief disciplinary petty officer aboard a naval ship
someone who has mastered the use of arms

explanation.surface: A senior non-commissioned officer on a ship is skilled with weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship the master-at-arms is the senior petty officer in charge of discipline, and literally a master at arms, skilled with weapons.

clue.text: More than mean

parts.note: above can mean in excess of, more than
the mean is the average of a set of numbers

explanation.surface: Something is greater than the arithmetical mean.
explanation.definitionFit: Anything greater than the mean of a set sits higher than the norm, beyond the middle value.

clue.text: Supercilious about or, gan-playing skill

indicators.note: the skill word goes round the other piece

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion

indicators.note: playing about with the word organ rearranges its letters

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is snooty about their organ-playing ability.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue reads 'organ-playing'; the scan's 'or, gan' is the one word split, so the organ is not the definition but fodder, and 'playing' works on its first part.
explanation.definitionFit: A supercilious person is haughty and disdainful, which is to be arrogant.

clue.text: Upset about work, drinks

indicators.note: the reversed word goes round the next piece
in a down clue, up means the word is written going upwards, backwards

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Distressed about the job, someone turns to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' must be read as two words, 'Up' (reverse, in a down clue) and 'set'; the surface sense of distress is the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is to drink alcohol heavily, so topes means drinks, as a verb.

clue.text: Performers tore up in disarray

indicators.note: things in disarray are jumbled up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Actors tear up the stage in chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A troupe is a company of touring performers such as actors or dancers.

clue.text: List of food

definitions.meaning: a register or list of names
a bread ... is a small item of food

explanation.surface: A menu of things to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll is both an official list of names and a small loaf of bread.

clue.text: Sleeping partner maybe has scope to finish on the board

parts.note: room means scope, as in room for improvement
checkmate ends a chess game on the board

explanation.surface: A business sleeping partner has the chance to wind up on the board of directors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sleeping partner' suggests a silent investor and 'board' a company's directors, but it is someone sharing a bedroom, and the chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sharing your bedroom is, in a literal sense, a partner in sleeping.

clue.text: Subject to reduced choice

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the final letter is lost

parts.note: a pick is a choice, as in take your pick

explanation.surface: Someone is limited to a smaller range of options.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject of discussion or writing.

clue.text: Offered to look after an assemblage of deer

parts.note: to tend is to look after

indicators.note: an assemblage is something put together from parts, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone volunteers to care for a herd of deer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an assemblage of' rearranges DEER into ERED.
explanation.definitionFit: Tendered means formally offered, as a resignation or payment is tendered.

clue.text: Drops down after washing up?

parts.note: read as the sea falling back after it has washed up on the shore, not dishwashing

explanation.definitionFit: The tide ebbs, or falls back, after the water has washed up the beach.

clue.text: Monk who founded an order on Scottish mountain

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
an edict is an official order

explanation.surface: A monk established a religious order on a Highland peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like part of the definition, a religious order, but it gives EDICT.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Benedict founded the Benedictine order of monks, so he is the monk who founded it.

clue.text: Work on it perhaps as a possibility

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the words may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Working on something might be one way forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges ON IT into TION; 'as' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An option is a possibility one may choose.

clue.text: Lacking bite?

parts.note: read as having no bite to eat rather than being toothless or feeble

explanation.definitionFit: Someone without a bite to eat is going hungry, close to famished.

clue.text: I start to improvise as a picture producer

indicators.note: improvising makes something up from what is at hand, so the letters are freshly arranged

explanation.surface: A painter begins making things up as they go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to improvise' rearranges I START; 'as a' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter produces pictures, so is a picture producer.

clue.text: It may reveal hidden charges

parts.note: read not as uncovering concealed fees but as finding buried explosives

explanation.definitionFit: This device locates buried explosive charges, such as landmines.

clue.text: Unwatered stock

definitions.meaning: a spirit served without water or mixer
cattle, an old word for oxen and livestock

explanation.definitionFit: Neat describes undiluted spirits and is also an old word for cattle.

clue.text: See a new kind of relief

indicators.note: making a new kind of something reshapes it, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Look at an innovative form of sculpture in relief.
explanation.definitionFit: Ease is relief from pain or worry.

clue.text: A team's pivot

parts.note: a team of eleven players is XI in Roman numerals, with the 's giving S

explanation.surface: A sports team's central player.
explanation.walkthrough: XI, eleven, is a football or cricket team.
explanation.definitionFit: An axis is a line or pivot around which something turns.

clue.text: Masters the conversion of hectares

indicators.note: converting something changes its form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Experts convert hectares into another unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Schoolmasters are teachers, so masters means teachers.

clue.text: Plea for a two point pact?

parts.note: E and N are two compass points, east and north
a treaty is a formal pact between states

explanation.surface: A request for an agreement made between two parties.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest request or plea.
